svg.title: The first-year response is led by export values
svg.desc: Separate local projections of export and import values after a 0.10-log-unit real effective depreciation. After twelve months, the export-value response is 8.41 log points, with a 95 percent interval of 5.95 to 10.88; the import-value response is 2.89, with an interval of minus 0.01 to 5.79. Both panels share a vertical scale. The models use outcome-specific lagged controls, so subtracting these separately estimated responses does not reproduce the direct export/import-ratio regression. These are nominal values, not volumes.
